I'm a CHL holder in Texas. I am largely ambivalent about open carry, it isn't something I personally care to do, although, I fully support those that wish to.

The biggest advantage in my mind, it that I have to worry less about printing. and if I decide to pull off my jacket, I can without it being a thing.

I still mostly conceal carry, but sometimes I OC. To me, it's more of a comfort thing. I like to dress appropriately and OC allows me to wear clothes that fit properly and look good while also allowing me to carry. It's nice to be able to tuck in a shirt without having to blouse it out a ton to conceal the grip of a concealed carry gun. Honestly, I don't think anyone ever notices, and if they do, I don't notice them noticing. In the winter I almost exclusively carry OWB, though often times my coat drapes over the gun and it's only visible when exiting my car or if the wind blows my coat or something. Once again, this is a comfort thing. The best and most comfortable IWB rig won't match the comfort of even a sub-par OC rig, in my opinion.

I honestly really wish more people who carried did so openly. It'd desensitize the public to the sight of firearms while also removing the stigma that guns and gun owners are bad people. They don't know you're carrying when it's concealed. But if they saw that most gun owners who carried weren't macho assholes who all dress tacitcool they'd probably like guns and gun owners better, even if they don't have any intention of ever owning a firearm. (Just my $0.02 anyway)

For the unaware:

OC = open carry IWB = Inside (the) Waistband... (concealed carry, unless it's hybrid-IWB which is still using a IWB holster but with the gun still openly visible) OWB = Outside (the) Waistband... (Most commonly method of open carry of pistols. A holster that is outside the waistband)
